eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Granite, MT; at 8:57 AM on AUG 15, 2026 Effective until 8:57 AM AUG 16, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Effective immediately, the Granite County Sheriff has LIFTED the Yellow Evacuation Warning south of the MT Hwy 38/Moose Lake Rd junction, EXCEPT for Frog Pond Basin. The RED EVACUATION ORDER for Frog Pond Basin remains in effect. Residents and visitors are advised to stay out of the area. Remain vigilant and ready to evacuate if conditions change.
